_source: POST /api/v1/projects/engagement-portal/access with a grantee no Keycloak user matches: AddProjectAccess returns fmt.Errorf("no Keycloak user found for grantee %q", grantee) (clients/keycloak.go:188-189), which AccessHandler.Add writes as writeError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to add access binding: "+err.Error()) (handlers/access.go:55-58). Served with status 500
error: failed to add access binding: no Keycloak user found for grantee "a.persn@kpmg.com.au"
